# Search Inside

# Search

One index over the docs, the service catalog and every node of the [map of the work](https://machinebehavior.io/map/): pages on the three sites, Substack posts, repositories and threads. It is rebuilt at each deploy. The data is at [/inside/search.json](https://machinebehavior.io/inside/search.json).

Inside search · index built by [build_search.py](https://github.com/uncovertechtalent/machinebehavior.io/blob/main/scripts/build_search.py)
